t: The Flomasta Double-Ended Plumbing Spanner is a lightweight plastic tool designed for installing and removing Flomasta 2" flush valves and 1/2" fill valves. Its double-ended, space-saving design reduces the need for multiple tools, while the compact 250mm length provides easy access in tight spaces around toilet cisterns. The lightweight plastic construction offers comfortable handling, improved control and helps prevent damage to plastic components during installation and maintenance.
b: For Use with Flomasta 2" Flush Valves & 1/2" Fill Valve
